description: Add app-level error boundary (app/error.tsx) and web app manifest (app/manifest.ts) to improve resilience and PWA readiness.
steps: Create app/error.tsx as a 'use client' component that catches runtime errors and displays a user-friendly error page with a retry button. Follow the styling conventions from not-found.tsx (centered layout, accent color, Tailwind utilities, semantic HTML). Include the error message in development mode only.

Create app/manifest.ts using Next.js MetadataRoute.Manifest type that exports a web app manifest with: name 'Kiro Hub', short_name 'Kiro Hub', description matching the metadata in layout.tsx, start_url '/', display 'standalone', theme_color matching the dark theme (#0a0a0a), background_color matching the dark theme (#0a0a0a), and appropriate icon references to the existing favicon.
Run npm run build and npm run lint to verify both new files work correctly
acceptance_criteria: app/error.tsx exists as a 'use client' component with proper error boundary UI
app/manifest.ts exists and generates a valid manifest.webmanifest at build time
The error page uses semantic HTML and Tailwind CSS responsive utilities per steering file
npm run build passes with exit code 0
npm run lint passes with no errors
verification: Run: npm run build - expect exit code 0 and manifest.webmanifest in output routes
Run: npm run lint - expect no errors
findings: Build and lint pass cleanly. manifest.webmanifest route confirmed in build output.
